title: Turkish Stew with Potatoes
description: A twist on traditional Turkish cuisine, this hearty stew combines tender beef with Japanese flavors and potatoes.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot.
Add more oil if needed, then sauté the ginger until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the stew, potatoes, soy sauce, and rice vinegar. Stir to combine.
Return the beef to the pot, cover, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 1/2 hours or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with green onions before serving.
